subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the repository accept these 14 new third-party action revisions in credentialed, publishing, security-scanning, and Codex workflows as one grouped update?
rationale: The patch has no mechanical defect, but accepting new executable supply-chain code across security-sensitive workflows is an ownership decision that CI cannot fully settle.

options.title: Approve grouped pins
options.body: Verify the upstream commits and release notes for the security-sensitive actions, then merge the exact head after required checks complete or the lone failure is confirmed unrelated.

options.title: Split privileged actions
options.body: Separate token, Docker publishing, CodeQL, and Codex Action updates into smaller PRs when maintainers want narrower review and rollback scope.

options.title: Pause the update
options.body: Keep the current pins until upstream behavior or exact-head workflow results provide enough confidence for the security-sensitive revisions.

recommendation.title: Approve grouped pins
recommendation.body: Verify the upstream commits and release notes for the security-sensitive actions, then merge the exact head after required checks complete or the lone failure is confirmed unrelated.

likelyOwner.reason: The cross-cutting change spans release, security, and repository automation, and the supplied timeline shows direct involvement from the project maintainer.
